setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A stargazer imagines distant settlements bright enough to hide the night sky.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Children delight in an imagined sea of lamps and illuminated windows.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The astronomer worries that bright nights could disturb animals and obscure constellations.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Researchers speculate about water, wind, heat, and other forces driving distant machinery.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A builder notes that every power source requires materials and maintenance.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village holds a quiet evening with fewer fires and admires the stars.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A night worker argues that reliable lighting can prevent injuries; the group seeks balance.
